deviations: The online-appendix control lists are unavailable. Controls were rebuilt from the data. Sociodemographics: sex, age bracket, employment status, CSP, education (4 levels), agglomeration size, region, household size, number aged 14+, left-right placement, smoker, main news source. Other motives: belief in environmental effectiveness and in progressivity. Incomes: continuous piecewise-linear terms in both adults' income percentiles with kinks at p20 and p70. Estimated gains: quadratic in the estimated net gain per consumption unit.

Estimated net gain = simule_gain (EUR/yr per consumption unit). Predicted winner = simule_gagnant, the displayed feedback; it differs from 1{simule_gain>0} for 56 respondents, 52 of them inside the |gain|<50 band.

Table 8: the progressivity belief is left out of the other-motive controls. It was only elicited in the survey wave that also received the effectiveness information (apres_modifs), so it is collinear with the instrument. The other-motive control there is the initial win/lose category.
Yellow Vests supporter = Gilets_jaunes in {soutient, est_dedans}. The initial win/lose belief G = initial category not 'Loser'. Column 3 also controls for the 3-level initial category.

Table 6 col 1 subsample = at least one adult's income percentile in [10,60] (both percentile variables as provided; 1,969 respondents). Eligibility instruments are traite_cible, traite_cible_conjoint and their product. Controls add policy-threshold fixed effects, a single-adult indicator and initial acceptance.

Table 8 instruments: apres_modifs = info on the scientific consensus about effectiveness (identified by its effect on the effectiveness belief) and info_CC. Strict definitions: approval = 'Oui', effective = 'Oui'.
Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors (coefficients do not depend on this).
notes: Data: the object s (3,002 respondents) from code/after_preparation.RData. memisc S4 columns were converted to base vectors because memisc is not installed. No scripts, logs or result files in the package were opened. Attempts 1-5 were exploratory and printed no RESULT lines. Attempts 2 and 3 crashed while converting the memisc columns. Before its final completed run, attempt 3 also hit Docker infrastructure failures: a 'Transport endpoint is not connected' mount error, hung containers stuck in 'Created', and a daemon crash. Docker Desktop was restarted and the identical script then ran. Attempt 6 was the first scored run. Its collinearity warning showed that the progressivity 'not asked' level was collinear with the effectiveness-information instrument, which collapsed the Table 8 first stage (F = 1.5). The final run drops that control from Table 8 only (first-stage F = 10.9). No paper values were consulted or compared. Paper numbers used were sample-description counts only: 1,968 feedback recipients and 1,969 respondents in the [p10;p60] subsample, both matched by construction.
